purpose: Pins the upstream taxonomy versions the CogSec adversarial fixture corpus derives from. A version bump here (or a failed hash check on regeneration) surfaces newly-uncovered taxonomy entries instead of silently passing. Regenerate with scripts/cogsec/fetch-corpus-upstream.mjs.

arcanum-pi-taxonomy.note: The repo publishes no release tags; v1.6.1 is the site-advertised version. The commit SHA is the machine-checkable pin. The taxonomy.json carries no version field — top level is the four axes.

mitre-atlas.note: dist/ATLAS.yaml is DEPRECATED upstream ('no longer being updated with new content') — do not pin it. Live data is dist/v6/ATLAS-<release>.yaml with monthly releases; manifest.yaml enumerates them. snapshotSha256 covers the full source YAML; only the technique id/name index is committed (the YAML is ~700KB and only needed at regeneration time).
